architecture.caption: Conceptual production architecture. Apache serves the Vite static build and PHP API. JSON/SSE application exchange and ArcadeDB REST/SQL retrieval are distinct from static asset delivery. Ollama is optional; it does not enumerate factual results. Domain boxes summarize the schema connection, not a complete instance graph. Numbered tiers match Figure 10. No benchmark or clinical-validity claim.

chatbot_pipeline.caption: Conceptual chatbot pipeline linked to architecture tiers 1 (browser), 2 (PHP) and 3 (ArcadeDB). Two left-to-right rows show the main path. Clarification revises input; unsupported paths/no records yield explicit responses. Structured context is revalidated for fresh KG retrieval. Optional model assistance uses validated facts for language only; results/citations are constructed deterministically. Failure and optional branches are schematic, not exhaustive control flow or timing measurements.
